title: Pan-Seared Hash Browns with Shallots
description: A classic French-inspired dish made with crispy hash browns, caramelized shallots, and a hint of Slovakian spice.

ingredients.name: Slovakian Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most international grocery stores

instructions: Peel and grate the potatoes, then squeeze out excess moisture.
In a bowl, mix together the hash browns, Slovakian spice blend, and a pinch of salt.
Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the hash browns to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes, until crispy and golden brown.
Transfer the hash browns to a baking sheet and bake for 10-12 minutes, until crispy.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter and cook until melted.
Add the sliced shallots to the skillet and cook for 5-7 minutes, until caramelized.
Serve the hash browns hot, topped with caramelized shallots and a sprinkle of Slovakian spice blend.
